name: attn-mla-deepseek-v2
note: QKV attention only, MLA (DeepSeek-V2): hidden 5120, 128 heads, q_lora_rank 1536, kv_lora_rank 512, qk head_dim 192 (128 nope + 64 rope), v_head_dim 128. Modeled as the distinctive two-stage low-rank query path (q_a 5120->1536, q_b 1536->128*192=24576) then attention and o_proj from 128*128=16384. The KV latent down/up projections are omitted because the linear-chain format cannot branch (q and KV both read hidden).
